articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
articles.snippet: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

articles.title: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
articles.snippet: Eligible institutions can pledge Benji-issued fund shares for stablecoin credit lines while keeping the underlying assets in off-exchange custody.

articles.title: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
articles.snippet: Fairshake pledged an initial $30 million on media opposing the Democratic candidate in Ohio’s Senate race in what some see as a repeat of spending by the crypto industry in 2024.
